reason: Article 5 addresses the prohibition of certain AI systems, which includes those that generate harmful content. This aligns with the control statement's focus on controlling harmful content and prohibited-use outputs.

Article 9 imposes obligations on high-risk AI systems, including requirements for data governance and robustness. These obligations are relevant to controlling the quality and safety of outputs, which encompasses sensitive data and malicious code.
Article 15 requires providers of general-purpose AI models to implement policies to prevent the generation of illegal content. This directly supports the control of prohibited-use outputs.
